entity.description: An Accounting book fact with ledger links. Revaluation changes the forward inventory cost without reposting historical movements. Partly issued assets are split to preserve the old asset and its posted history.
The exact reviewed revaluation scope and input fingerprint. Posting recomputes and locks those inputs; the preview is not a second stock ledger.

An organization's book defaults for an asset class (the AssetClass enumeration, which named classes before and gave no defaults), as dated versions: AssetBookServices.store#Class ends the version in effect where the next starts. Capitalization adopts the version in effect on the in-service day; an asset keeps the basis it adopted when the class changes later.

field.name: assetTypeEnumId
field.description: The fixed asset type the class applies to

field.name: salvagePercent
field.description: The residual value as a percent of the acquire cost

field.name: gainGlAccountId
field.description: The credit account of a gain on disposal

field.name: lossGlAccountId

field.name: productId
field.description: The Asset is an Instance of this Product (for inventory, maintenance schedules/etc, content about what sort of thing the Asset is, etc)

field.name: hasQuantity
field.description: If Y asset has a quantity and QOH/ATP may be greater than one. If N (default) asset is a single item and may have a serial number, etc.

field.name: originalQuantityUomId
field.description: QOHT and ATPT are in units of the Product (amountUomId). This field specifies the original UOM (along with originalQuantity) when it differs from Product.amountUomId.

field.name: bookable
field.description: Y when this asset can be booked on a calendar (equipment). Type AstTpEquipment alone does not make it bookable.

field.name: containerId
field.description: Container stored in, if specified the current facilityId and locationSeqId should come from the container and not from this record or with standard EECA rule in place facilityId and locationSeqId will be set and maintained from the Container values.

field.name: originId
field.description: Origin ID, the ID used wherever this came from.

field.name: originFacilityId
field.description: Origin Facility, where manufactured or came from.

field.name: acquireWorkEffortId
field.description: For assets created from production runs, etc.
